slug: 2023-06-07 Barriers, facilitators and motivators of electronic community health information system use among health workers in Ethiopia

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with development partners (study funded by USAID Digital Health Activity)
systems.tiers: health extension workers at health posts and house to house; releases 1 and 2 in more than 7,000 health posts by 2022, releases 3 to 5 in pilot; dashboards used at health centres and woreda health offices

systems.platform: paper family folders and tickler file
systems.tiers: health posts; in use since 2008 and still mandatory in parallel with eCHIS in May 2022

note: The study is about eCHIS, a system used by community health workers (class community), so it gives no HMIS or EMR fact; the national HMIS is named only for its principles.
